finding.model_bundle: The fixed three-component bundle had mean unique-number coverage 16.0527131783 across 645 targets; it did not satisfy the policy's required 18-number union geometry.
finding.random_comparator: The E019 report specifies three independent uniform six-number tickets per target. Independent sampling permits overlaps and does not preserve three pairwise-disjoint tickets with union18.
finding.consequence: E019 is not a geometry-matched comparator for the 1251+ policy and cannot be used as strict three-line evidence. Its POST_HOC_EXPLORATORY classification and historical results remain unchanged.

independently_recomputed_exact_null.method: Multivariate-hypergeometric enumeration over category sizes [6,6,6,27], summing all nonnegative draw allocations totaling 6 and grouping by maximum hits in any of the three disjoint tickets.

required_for_future_1251_evaluation: Every candidate portfolio must contain exactly three six-number tickets.
All 18 numbers must be unique across the three tickets.
The same-target random comparator must preserve the exact same disjoint-union18 geometry.
Use the policy's exact null values and preregistered adjusted moving-block CI and 50-target block-stability gates.
No threshold, alpha, block size, or comparator changes are authorized by this correction.
